description: FastAPI service that serves the crop yield model in a container
readme:
# ML deploy service

Proof project from week 2 of my roadmap. The crop yield model is now served
as a REST API instead of a notebook.

Model deployment: FastAPI app, model loaded once at startup, /predict takes
a JSON payload and returns the prediction with the model version. MLflow
tracks the runs and the artifact lives in an S3 bucket read through boto3.

The Dockerfile is a two stage build, final image is 310 MB. GitHub Actions
runs pytest and builds the image on every push.
